Photo 1 is a similar view of the same bottom, showing the same logo and design.
Photo 2 shows the back of a black box with white text and symbols, including CE and other certification marks.
The box in photo 2 has Chinese characters and some English text, including 'WARNING' and 'DO NOT OPEN'.
The device in photos 0 and 1 appears to be a console, likely a PS4 Slim, based on the shape and logo.
